normalization: sum of squared real orthonormal coefficients over zonal orders, divided by 4*pi; constant mode retained
forecast_aggregation: Mean of individual-member powers; ensemble-mean-field spectrum reported separately
date_aggregation: Equal mean over paired dates with complete truth for that variable/level/lead; require and retain all eight case reports, report actual support per panel
notes: No planar FFT or downsampling. Finite-grid quadrature is a numerical approximation at high wavenumbers. Paper prose does not fully specify the numerical transform backend/normalization; this convention is explicit and shared by both models and truth.
missing_truth_policy: Do not interpolate or zero-fill incomplete truth fields. Retain a missing_truth row with missing-grid-point count; exclude that case/variable/level/lead from both models in paired spectral averages. All forecasts and all other metrics retain their original scope.
